members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Students and staff of the university: roles and access to the platform.
members.subtitleReadOnly: Students and staff of the university. Roles are changed by the administrator.
members.emptyText: Import students from CSV or XLSX — they will receive invitations.
members.emptyFilteredText: Change the search or the filters.
members.selfAdmin: You cannot remove the administrator role from yourself — ask another administrator.

roleHints.tenant_admin: Full access to the university settings

members.suspendText: The member loses access to the platform at once. Their data is kept, and access can be restored.
members.activateText: The member will be able to sign in again.

import.title: Data import
import.subtitle: Upload the university structure or a list of students from CSV or XLSX. You first see a preview with errors for every row — nothing is saved until you confirm.

kind.label: What to import
kind.studentsText: Email, full name, group, faculty and year. New students receive an invitation.
kind.structureText: Faculties, departments and study groups in three languages.

upload.drop: Drop the file here or click to choose it
upload.rules: CSV (UTF-8 or Windows-1251) or XLSX up to 10 MB and 3000 rows
upload.wrongType: A CSV or XLSX file is needed.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB. Split it into parts.

columns.title: File columns
columns.text: The first row holds the headers. Use the English names below or their Russian and Kazakh equivalents, as in the template.
columns.studentsHint: The roles column may list roles separated by commas: student, supervisor, mentor, jury. The default is student. Other roles are assigned under Members.
columns.structureHint: Level of study: bachelor, master, doctorate, or the Russian бакалавриат, магистратура, докторантура.

preview.invalidHint_one: {{count, number}} row with errors will be skipped. Fix the file and upload it again, or import the remaining rows.
preview.invalidHint_other: {{count, number}} rows with errors will be skipped. Fix the file and upload it again, or import the remaining rows.
preview.title: Preview
preview.studentsNote: New students receive an email inviting them to set a password.
preview.structureNote: Faculties, departments and groups with the same codes are updated.
